title: Addressing contingency in algorithmic (mis)information classification: Toward a responsible machine learning agenda
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not benchmark any aspect of faith or religion. Its focus is on the process of building machine learning models for (mis)information classification.
languages_evaluated: The dataset covers 41 languages, but they are not individually listed.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as it is not a focus of the research.
